backup.scope: All original campaign runs and frozen Git source; recovery receipts stored alongside the archive.

costs.proxy: Scalar additions and multiplies separately; nonlinear calls count once. Training estimate uses twice-forward for backward and ten operations per parameter per Adam update; not measured FLOPs.
costs.scope: All supervised runs including preflight, failed search, injection and recovery. Forward proxy and training estimate overlap and must not be added. Host-side generator, serialization and audit arithmetic is not counted by these proxies. Seconds are supervised worker wall time, not total human or agent time. Artifact bytes are allocated run-directory bytes, not backup/restore storage.

coverage.aggregate_scope: selected measurement only; no pooling across training checkpoints

decision.comparison: Not confirmed: direct recurrent baseline fails mixed short-sequence validation at both permitted rates.
limitations: Three initialization seeds in one finite world and one shared development set; no population confidence interval.
Supplied observed-bit state, fixed action bank selection and every-prefix supervision strongly match the simulator algebra.
Both learned arms recur; no isolated recurrence, representation-discovery, learned selective-activation, speedup or architecture claim.
Sorted-action control leaves the ascending held-out pair family and one-step family unchanged; reversed actions diagnose the pair family.
Intermediate target-state values may overlap even though complete trajectories and effective initial-state/action inputs do not.
Scalar checks sample twelve trajectories; complete numerical replay uses the same PyTorch dependency.
decision.retain: Finite development composition by learned transitions with supplied observation-aligned state; all three seeds acquire and score every development family exactly.

development_transfer.controls_scope: Exact sorted simulator is a labeled order-insensitive oracle control, never part of learned inference. Reversed actions are scored against the original ordered target.

input_audit.scope: Finite complete input and prefix signatures; fixed preprocessing has no quotient symmetry. Net-transform exclusions cover every allowed training word and prefix, not just sampled rows. Final trajectory labels remain unrendered. Initial-state partitions do not forbid overlap of intermediate target states.

metric_projection: All selected-snapshot metrics retain integer support by action, length and family. Each of 120 saved curve points retains loss, length metrics, worst action exactness, worst required-slice changed-bit accuracy and snapshot identity. Complete action/family curves, minibatches, labels, logits and snapshots remain in the private verified archive.

preflight.scope: Synthetic independent labels, numerical execution and throughput only; no acquisition.

protocol.artifact_rights: Own-initialized parameters and synthetic data; private same-disk backup authorized by owner, no publication or retirement.
protocol.claim_boundary: Supplied observed-state coordinates, action bank and prefix supervision; fixed learned transitions versus dense recurrent sequence predictor. Limited composition probe, no original foundation, selective activation, continual learning or language claim.
protocol.confirmation: Separate registration after development; five fresh paired seeds, frozen settings, final-family effects and failed-seed treatment. No final tuning.

data.final_access: Only a committed separate confirmation registration may render final trajectories. Structural counts may be audited before fitting.

protocol.preflight: 24 synthetic-label updates per arm, length 3; 8 warmup and 16 timed. Project 2048 updates below 70 seconds before admitting fitting. Durations are fixed equally across learning rates; stop rather than alter them after observing acquisition.
protocol.search_rule: Run all three seeds at lr003 per arm/stage. Use lr010 only if lr003 lacks all-seed acquisition. Advance an arm only after all three seeds pass its preceding stage. Select the first all-seed-passing condition. Development transfer requires all-seed mixed acquisition. Confirmation requires direct baseline acquisition; a candidate failure remains a scoped result.
protocol.teacher_assistance: Own synthetic simulator supplies every prefix label; Codex assisted development code.

training.selection: Lowest validation loss among measurements passing every acquisition slice; tiny uses training loss. If none qualifies, retain failure and the lowest-loss diagnostic snapshot.
training.stage_initialization: Each stage and condition starts from fresh parameters, with paired arm seeds and identical minibatch schedules.
training.supervision: All prefix outcome bits for both arms, free running from the initial state. No intermediate observations are fed at inference or by teacher forcing.

verification.delivery_ci: Exact evidence-delivery commit and completed hosted checks are recorded in the delivery report; do not infer from frozen-source CI.
